title.en: SAMPLE: An AI controller steadies a fusion test machine
title.zh: SAMPLE：AI 控制器穩定了核融合實驗裝置

found.en: An AI controller held a plasma steady in a fusion test machine for 90 seconds, three times longer than the standard controller.
found.zh: AI 控制器讓核融合實驗裝置中的電漿（plasma）穩定維持了 90 秒，是標準控制器的三倍。

matters.en: Fusion machines need steady control to work, and long runs are hard to reach. Better control is one step toward fusion power.
matters.zh: 核融合裝置需要穩定的控制才能運作，而長時間運轉很難做到。更好的控制，是邁向核融合發電的一步。

ai_helped.en: Fernhill Fusion Group built the Fernhill Controller, which adjusted the magnets 1,000 times a second. It learned from practice runs.
ai_helped.zh: Fernhill Fusion Group 開發了 Fernhill Controller，它每秒調整磁鐵 1,000 次。它從練習運轉中學習。

how_sure.en: Checked. Fusion Science Reports published the paper after peer review. Fernhill Fusion Group built the controller, and other groups have not yet repeated the run.
how_sure.zh: 已查核。Fusion Science Reports 在同儕審查後發表了這篇論文。控制器由 Fernhill Fusion Group 開發，其他團隊還沒有重現這次運轉。

background.en: Fusion power needs a very hot gas held in place by magnets.
background.zh: 核融合發電需要一種被磁鐵固定在原位的極高溫氣體。

could_lead.en: If other groups repeat the run, AI control could become a standard part of fusion machines.
could_lead.zh: 如果其他團隊重現這次運轉，AI 控制可能成為核融合裝置的標準配備。

evidence.quote: The controller, built by Fernhill Fusion Group, adjusted the magnets 1,000 times a second
